positive_snippets: Very nice hotel for stay. Rooms are very neat and cleans. They also gives you food in your room as per your order. Staff is very supportive and polite.

I recently stayed at Hotel Pitrashish Premium in Karol Bagh and had a decent experience overall. The location is definitely a big plus—centrally situated, with easy access to metro stations, markets, and popular landmarks in Delhi. The staff was polite, helpful, and check-in was quick. The room was clean, fairly spacious, and equipped with basic amenities like Wi-Fi, TV, AC, and a comfortable bed. Housekeeping was responsive, and the power backup ensured a hassle-free stay.  The food service was good, especially in the evening, and the quality was super.  For the price point and convenience, Hotel Pitrashish is a good option for budget travelers or anyone looking for a short stay in the heart of Delhi. Happy customer.. will definitely come back...

Hotel Pitrashish Premium & Grand is one of the worst experiences I have had. The rooms were dirty, the bathrooms unhygienic, and the facilities poorly maintained.
